abstract: PwC's 2025 AI Jobs Barometer reports that workers with AI skills command a 56% wage premium over non-AI peers, a dramatic increase from 25% one year prior, with median AI role compensation reaching $157,000. The study documents the rapidly escalating market value of artificial intelligence expertise in the labor market.
keyFindings: Workers with AI skills command a 56% wage premium over non-AI peers, up from 25% one year prior.
Median compensation for AI roles reaches $157,000.
